# All diffs vs ORIGINAL v001 frames; 25-px rule (>=25 px total >12/255 outside the chest = FAIL). Ink tolerance |delta rel| <= 0.08.

# Summary: 5 PASS, 0 FAIL. C02-014 v004 and C04-013/015 v004 are in the earlier frozen returns. With these, all C04 redos have a PASS on the latest version (001/008 per earlier returns; 008 face OPEN).

column4: Ghost N: at 4x and with autocontrast over the old ghost spot (x543-551, y636-650) and the re-inpainted ring (x<565, y625-662), the faint second contour from v003 is gone. No outline, smear or seam. The v004-minus-v003 diff shows only the removed contour plus noise. Outside vs ORIGINAL: max 10, 0 px >12. Disc 131.8/119.3 = 1.10 (sweep 1.093-1.105), under 1.15. Spire/disc 0.56. Ink 0.353-0.40 rel (my ruler), stroke 2.0/4.0, chest unchanged from v003 except the ring. touchup_type=local inpaint + single save; edge OK.

Claimed sha 00dc84d4 verified. RIM ARC FIRST: at 4x with autocontrast over x600-705, y575-600 the v004 dome arc is gone and the skin is clean. Arc band (y575-600, x595-710) v005 vs v003: max 4, 0 px >5 (Z_9 claim of <=5 holds). The row-mean profile is a smooth gradient (75.6 to 59.1), with no dark dip where the arc was (the original dips to 34). Ghost N. Outside vs ORIGINAL: max 13, 2 px >12 (claim confirmed, under the 25-px rule; JPEG). Chest identical to v003: 3111 ship-ink px, max diff 12, mean 0.61, 0 px >12. Ink 0.381 rel vs blaster 0.355 (delta 0.026, within 0.08). Disc/spires as v003 (passed on chest). Edge OK.

Claimed sha 9b7f5e76 verified. Spires shortened: spire/disc 0.535 by my rim ruler (42.8 px over an 80.1 disc; was 0.85 in v003; Z_9 0.55), inside the 0.41-0.69 band. Disc 80.1 vs old 87.1 tip-to-tip = 0.92 (the alt sweep with a wider old mask gives 0.886-0.90). Same disc as v003 and at the floor but passing; Z_9 0.92 agrees. Ghost N: the 124 removed v003 spire-tip px now read as skin (rel 1.01). Outside vs ORIGINAL: max 7, 0 px >12. Ink 0.318 rel vs blaster 0.323 (same method; hand-box 0.429 vs 0.412), stroke 2.0/2.83. Edge OK.

Claimed sha 1ed80f0b verified. 4x zoom over x690-725, y655-710 and along the mask edge: the v003 beam strokes, including the one that leaked back through the feathered edge, are gone, with no leftover stroke and no seam at the shirt edge. The darker tone right of the hull (mean 61.6) matches the original's natural shadow there (63.6). Texture sd is 2.55-5.0 vs 3.07 on untouched skin, so no smear or texture mismatch. The old right dome/smudge right of the right spire is clean. Ghost N (18 stray v003-ink px not in the ship component, none visible at 4x). Outside vs ORIGINAL: max 10, 0 px >12. Ship unchanged from v003: disc 0.93-1.04, spire/disc ~0.64 (the auto 0.73 here is skewed by the tilted rim; by hand, tips y613 / rim y665-671 on ~82-86 px = 0.62-0.69). Ink 0.35 rel. Blaster in this dark purple light can't be measured reliably (0.25-0.37 depending on box), so the v003 ink call stands. Edge OK.

Claimed sha 2b7cbb7a verified. Visible disc 109.0 vs old 106.4 = 1.02-1.03 (sweep 0.99-1.03; Z_9 0.95). The whole rim shows, tip to tip x607-716, inside the shirt opening. Spire/disc 0.41 by my rim ruler (44.7 px; Z_9 0.535): at the floor of the 0.41-0.69 band, so the spires read short/stubby but it is still the twin-tower design (borderline note; ~0.5 would sit closer to ref 0.55). PLACEMENT: natural. Centred on the sternum between the pec lines, filling the shirt V like the other C04 frames (cf. 013 v005) and the C41-020 ref; not floating, not clipped. Rim tips clear the shirt edges by ~5 px. OFFSET from the original saucer centre (rim midpoint ~x659,y602 to ~x661.5,y598): +2.5 px x, -4.5 px y (5.1 px, ~0.024 of the ~210 px shirt-opening chest width at y600). Vs v003 the disc moved up ~25-30 px; whole-ship bbox centre ~y608 vs old saucer ~y607. Old beam strokes and pods below the hull (y640-700) are clean at 4x. Ghost N (189 uncovered old-ink px are shirt-edge shadow). Outside vs ORIGINAL: max 11, 0 px >12. Ink 0.375 rel vs blaster 0.372 (hand-box 0.442 vs 0.420), stroke 2.0/4.0. Edge OK.
